lead_time_analysis.stability: unstable — CV>0.9, single spike at 3.1 days

narrative: Material PL3__M91F4E56 exhibits lumpy, right-skewed demand with a statistically significant upward trend (slope +3.0 units/working day, p<0.001). Lead times are short on average (0.62 days) but highly variable (CV=0.94), with one spike to 3.1 days. The current SAP policy carries zero safety stock, leaving the material exposed to frequent stockouts. A continuous-review (r,Q) policy with SS=282 and OQ=1,188 achieves the 95% service level target at an incremental annual cost of approximately $763.
warnings: SAP safety stock is 0 — no buffer against demand or lead-time variability
Significant increasing demand trend detected — policy should be recalibrated quarterly
4 demand outliers winsorised at upper bound of 601.18 units

research_insights.selection_rationale: Lumpy intermittent demand with high CV and a rising trend is best served by a fixed reorder-point / fixed order-quantity policy. The EOQ minimises total inventory cost while the ROP provides explicit service-level-linked stockout protection. Periodic review would add unnecessary latency given the short lead times.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage constraint is non-binding at 17.4% utilisation (1,470 of 8,427 max units). No capacity risk identified.
